Package com.privatechain.storage.memory

package com.privatechain.storage.memory
In-memory storage backend — ephemeral, zero-dependency block storage backed by a LinkedHashMap (FR-STOR-02).

InMemoryStorage is the default storage used by BlockchainConfig.builder() when no explicit backend is configured. It is suitable for unit tests, integration tests, and runnable demos where persistence across JVM restarts is not required.

Thread safety: all reads use a shared ReadLock; writes use an exclusive WriteLock via a ReentrantReadWriteLock (FR-STOR-06).
